The '''decay mites''' were insects native to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], found also on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Rot_mite.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A rot mite.]]
Decay mites were insects from Talus.<ref name="SWG:GDMC" /> They walked on six legs, and possessed two grasping arms with pincers, eight limbs in total. Races and subspecies included the dung mite and the rot mite, also found on Talus.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a swarm of giant decay mites lived in a [[Giant Decay Mite Cave|cave]] on the planet Talus. [[Scientist/Legends|Scientists]] believed that something in the rock of the cave had triggered these impressive changes within the insects.<ref name="SWG:GDMC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Decay mites appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
